instruction: Remove italic formatting from all text in the document while keeping the text content unchanged

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires removing all italic formatting. Document originally has 21 italic runs (AVL tree, u, preorder, postorder, etc.). Evaluator checks that no runs have italic=True.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirement: checks that all text has italic formatting removed
Metric iterates through all paragraphs and runs, checking each run's italic property - this covers the main text content
Data flow is correct: postconfig saves document → get_vm_file retrieves it → metric checks italic formatting
Binary verification logic is appropriate: returns 0.0 if any italic found, 1.0 if none found
Error handling is present for document open failures
Postconfig properly saves the file before verification to ensure latest state is retrieved
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor limitation: metric only checks doc.paragraphs, doesn't check tables, headers, footers, or text boxes. For most LibreOffice Writer tasks this is sufficient, but could be enhanced if document has complex structures with italic text in those elements
